title: fix(rest)!: answer 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for an unknown resource at the package draft, flow runs and datasource by-name doors
body:
Fixes #25486

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

**BREAKING** (a served-set narrowing of eight REST doors): a request that names a package id, flow name or datasource name that does not exist is now refused `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. Five of these doors used to answer it `200` with an empty result, and three answered `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`. The changeset ships `patch` with the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: no metadata key changes, only the HTTP answer for a resource that is not there.

## What changes

Eight doors answered a request about a resource that does not exist as if it were empty or malformed, while their sibling doors answered `404` for the same name. Each now answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` with its sibling's status, code and message. `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` is an existing standard code; no new code is registered.

| door | before | after | sibling it now matches |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/publish-drafts` (unknown id) | `200 { success: false, outcome: 'nothing_to_publish' }` | `404 "Package 'ID' not found"` | `GET /api/v1/packages/:id` |
| `POST /api/v1/packages/:id/discard-drafts` (unknown id) | `200 { success: true, discardedCount: 0 }` | same `404` | `GET /api/v1/packages/:id` |
| `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/commits` (unknown id) | `200 { commits: [] }` | same `404` | `GET /api/v1/packages/:id` |
| `GET /api/v1/automation/:name/runs` (unknown flow) | `200 { runs: [], hasMore: false }` | `404 "Flow 'NAME' not found"` | `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/trigger` |
| `DELETE /api/v1/automation/:name` (unknown flow) | `200 { name, deleted: true }` | same `404` | `POST /api/v1/automation/:name/trigger` |
| `PATCH /api/v1/datasources/:name` (unknown name) | `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR "Datasource 'NAME' not found."` | `404 'Datasource "NAME" does not exist.'` | `GET /api/v1/datasources/:name`, word for word |
| `DELETE /api/v1/datasources/:name` (unknown name) | same `400` | same `404` | `GET /api/v1/datasources/:name` |
| `POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/migrate-credential` (unknown name) | same `400` | same `404` | `GET /api/v1/datasources/:name` |

A resource that exists keeps its answer: an empty runs page, `nothing_to_publish`, an empty commit trail, and `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` for a code-defined datasource are all unchanged.

### Where absence is decided, per door

- **Datasource (the card's A1).** The producer is `DatasourceAdminService`: `updateDatasource`, `removeDatasource` and `migrateCredential` threw a plain `Error`. They now throw `datasourceNotFoundError(name)`, which carries `code: 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'` and `status: 404` (the same shape as the service's existing `metadataIncompleteError` 503). Its message is `GET`'s own words, `Datasource "NAME" does not exist.`. The route's error renderer (`badRequest` in `admin-routes.ts`) relays that envelope, exactly as it already relayed the 503. All four by-name doors of `datasource-admin` are covered; `GET` was already right.
- **Runs (A2).** `GET /:name/runs` now asks `flowIsUnknown` (`packages/runtime/src/flow-dispatch-status.ts`) before listing. That is the trigger door's own registry probe and message, reused rather than written a second time. It is asked before the query is judged, as the trigger door asks it. A service without `getFlow` cannot be asked, so it lists as before.
- **Flow delete.** Measured before the fix: `200 { name, deleted: true }`. `unregisterFlow` is a no-op for a name the engine does not hold, and `deleteMetaItem` answers a name with no row `{ success: true, reset: false }` ("nothing to delete"). `unregisterAndDeleteFlow` now asks `flowIsUnknown`. It answers `404` with `flowNotFoundMessage` only when the engine did not hold the flow AND the store deleted no row (`reset !== true`).
- **Publish-drafts (A3).** Measured. The registry (`qlService.registry.getPackage`) is the existence authority every package read sibling answers its 404 from. Authored packages are installed into it too (`POST /packages`, `service-package` at boot). The runtime packages domain decides absence, so `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is untouched, and no #25467 region is near this diff. The 404 is answered only when the protocol's answer was empty (`nothing_to_publish`), nothing was un-hidden, no visibility-flip failure was recorded (`unhideError`), and the registry lacks the id. Drafts the protocol holds for such an id are still published.
- **Discard-drafts and commits.** These use the same `packageIsUnknown` rule, after the protocol answers and only when that answer is empty. Drafts or commits held for an id the registry lacks are still discarded or listed. `discard-drafts` is the twin of `publish-drafts`, fixed in place under os-dev rule 3's bounded exemption. `commits` and flow delete were added in the seat's patch round, as members of this closing card's family in the files this PR already edits.

### Consumers (A4)

`ObjectStackClient.fetch` throws on any non-2xx answer, using the envelope's message. So `packages.publishDrafts`, `packages.discardDrafts`, `packages.listCommits`, `automation.listRuns` and `automation.delete` now reject loudly for an unknown id; there is no crash path. No in-repo non-test consumer calls these doors for an id it did not first install or register: the dogfood callers all `POST /packages` first. objectui consumers: see trade-off (b) below.

## Accepted trade-offs (recorded; no code change)

- **(a)** An orphan commit trail, whose package the registry no longer lists but which still has commits, is still served `200`. `GET /api/v1/automation/:name/runs/:runId` still answers by run id alone, as before.
- **(b)** A draft-only flow, stored but not registered in the engine, now gets `404` at `GET /:name/runs`. Before, it got an empty page. objectui's `FlowRunsPanel.tsx` (around lines 240–244) renders that rejection as "unavailable".
- **(c)** `DELETE /:name` counts existence in the store or the engine, while runs, trigger and `GET /:name` count the engine only. That asymmetry is what keeps a flow that failed to register deletable at this door.

## Pins (whole-repo sweep)

- Flipped, now asserting the new substance: `datasource-admin-service.test.ts`. The three "missing datasource" cases asserted `toThrow(/not found/)`. They now assert `{ code: 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND', status: 404, message: 'Datasource "nope" does not exist.' }`. `envelope.conformance.test.ts`: the "credential-migration failure" row used a not-found message for its `400` case. It now uses a store failure, because an unknown name no longer takes that arm.
- New pins. Each asserts `status` plus `error.code` plus the named resource, and adds a side-by-side parity case against the sibling door:
  - `service-datasource/src/__tests__/datasource-unknown-name.test.ts`: the real service behind the real routes. All four by-name doors give one answer: status, code and message. Nothing is written. Controls: a known datasource patches, and a code-defined one is still `400`.
  - `runtime/src/domains/automation-runs-unknown-flow.test.ts`: `404` with the store never asked. Parity with `POST /:name/trigger`. Existence is judged before the query. Control: an existing flow with no runs still gets `200 []`.
  - `runtime/src/domains/automation-delete-unknown-flow.test.ts`: `404` naming the flow. Parity with the trigger door. Controls: an engine-held flow and a stored-only flow are both still deleted, `200`.
  - `runtime/src/domains/packages-draft-doors-unknown-package.test.ts`: `publish-drafts`, `discard-drafts` and `commits` all answer `404`, each in parity with `GET /packages/:id`, which is itself asserted `404`. Controls: a known empty package gets `200` at all three doors. Drafts held for an unregistered id still publish and still discard. Commits held for an unregistered id are still listed. An un-hidden app is reported, not answered `404`. A failed visibility flip answers `200` with its `unhideError`.
- Swept with no hit on the old semantics: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` (`integration-system.datasource-admin-lifecycle` already states "unknown name → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND"), `packages/qa/dogfood/test/**`, `packages/cli/test/**`, `packages/client/src/**`.

## Verification record

Final head `f3e50da5f`, on base merge `7da7e5a59` (from `origin/main` `481ac6211`).

- **Dogfood battery** at `f3e50da5f`, run under `os-verify-lock` with CI's command `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (no shard, no path): `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Test Files: 293 passed, 3 skipped (296). Tests: 2509 passed, 18 skipped (2527). No failure.
- **Changed-package tests** at `f3e50da5f`:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 443 passed (443). Tests 7055 passed, 19 skipped (7074).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test`: Test Files 57 passed (57). Tests 975 passed (975).
  - `typecheck` of both packages: exit 0.
  - `eslint --no-inline-config` on the touched files: exit 0.
- **Fast gates** at `f3e50da5f`, each exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration` (one declared-breaking changeset, disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`.
- **Full derived gate set** (`dispatch-gates --ran`), last run on `71d6c23c4`: 72 families derived, 71 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED. That one is `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3: it needs every package's `dist/`, and CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- **Measured before each patch-round fix**: the commits door and flow delete each answered `200` (`expected 200 to be 404`).
- **Ablations**, one per changed behaviour, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. Each mutation landed on disk with the anchor count going 1 → 0, and each was restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty. Subjects are imported from `src`, so no `dist` leg applies.
  - Datasource 404 relay off: 4 failed, 2 passed.
  - Runs `flowIsUnknown` off: 3 failed, 1 passed.
  - Draft doors `packageIsUnknown` forced false: 3 failed, 3 passed.
  - Delete `unknownToEngine && !rowDeleted` off: 2 failed, 2 passed.
  - Commits `packageIsUnknown` off: 2 failed, 8 passed.
  - `unhideError` guard deleted: 1 failed, 11 passed. A first attempt with an empty replacement was refused by the tool as a no-op and is not counted.
  - Datasource message reverted to the old words: 1 failed (parity), 5 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- The `external-datasource` by-name doors (`GET /api/v1/datasources/:name/remote-tables`, `POST …/:name/test`, `POST …/:name/object-draft`) are left as they are. `external-datasource-service.ts` records not throwing for an unknown datasource as deliberate: whether an unknown datasource is an error there is a question about the driver registration, and that service's comment declines to make it a throw.
- `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.outcome`'s describe says `nothing_to_publish` means "the package had no pending drafts". That is still true at the protocol; the REST door now answers `404` before an unknown package reaches it. No spec text is changed here (`Metadata-protocol: none`).
